item.description:
### Changed - **Droid: a question shows on the row.** When Droid asks you something, the row and the "needs you" alert now show the question ("Question: Red or blue?") instead of "Factory CLI is asking the user 1 question(s)". - **Droid: the "finished" notification says what Droid replied,** when the turn ended with a reply. A turn that ended on a command or tool still gets the plain "Droid finished its turn."
### Fixed - **Uninstalling with `scripts/uninstall.sh` puts your own Antigravity status line back exactly as it was,** including one you had turned off. If it can't be restored, the saved copy is kept and the script tells you where. Its backups of your settings are now private to you.
